title: Kwaliteitskaart Voortgezet Onderwijs 2005
descriptions: Statistics collected by the Dutch Education Inspectorate (Inspectie van het Onderwijs) from schools for secondary education regarding examination results, intake, school-leaving and transfer of pupils / pupils from cultural minorities / primary schooladvice. In this 2005 survey data about study costs allowances were not collected.
